name: Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited
summary: Dongfang Electric Corporation Limited (DEC) is a prominent entity in the global energy sector, specializing in the design, development, production, and distribution of power generation equipment both within China and across international markets. Its operations are diversified across five distinct segments: Renewable Energy Equipment, Clean and Efficient Energy Equipment, Engineering and Trade, Modern Manufacturing Services Industry, and Emerging Growth Industry. DEC's comprehensive portfolio supports electricity generation from a wide array of sources, including wind, solar, hydropower, nuclear, gas, and thermal power. The company boasts substantial installed capacities for various equipment types, including 8,101 megawatts (MW) of hydro-generating units, 25,028 MW of steam turbine generators, 3,370 MW of wind power units, 23,929 MW of power station steam turbines, and 22,017 MW of power station boilers. Beyond manufacturing, Dongfang Electric also provides specialized engineering contracting and a range of services to energy operators globally. Established in 1993 and headquartered in Chengdu, People's Republic of China, the company underwent a name change in October 2007, transitioning from Dongfang Electric Machinery Co., Ltd. to its current designation. It operates as a subsidiary of Dongfang Electric Corporation.
